name: llama.cpp
what: The reference GGUF inference engine. llama-server serves one model per process over an OpenAI-style API with every knob exposed on the command line.

detect.note: a unit is proposed from a running llama-server (its -m and --port), since there is no configuration file convention

can: start a unit with its recorded argv
treat it as loaded while it answers /health
cannot: unload without stopping: one model for the server's life
change the context without a restart

never: --host 0.0.0.0 without a reverse proxy in front: there is no login

update.note: Releases are build numbers (b1234). Download the archive that matches your CUDA or CPU and replace the folder; the check compares the running build to the newest release.

windows: Download llama-<build>-bin-win-cuda-<cuda>-x64.zip (and the matching cudart zip) from the releases page, unpack beside each other, put the folder on PATH.
linux: Download the matching tarball, or build: cmake -B build -DGGML_CUDA=ON && cmake --build build --config Release -j

good: any GGUF, any quant, exact control of layers, context and KV types
not: a store, a pull command, or a UI: bring your own
